description: Put the ink away with nothing copied.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Stopped at the entrance, and named her careful.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Said the boy talks like a man who has read too many sonnets.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Kept the old man, and liked him better than the young one.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Played the napkin straight, and asked for no song.
name: Will Kemp

description: Wrote the scrap and closed the bundle.
name: William Shakespeare
